CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cm_get_alert_stats()
 RETURNS TABLE(category text, status text, count bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
  SELECT 
    category,
    status,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM cm_alerts
  GROUP BY category, status
  ORDER BY category, status;
$function$

functions.name: cm_resolve_alert_by_reference
functions.identity_args: p_kaipoke_cs_id text, p_category text, p_reference_id text, p_resolution_note text
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cm_resolve_alert_by_reference(p_kaipoke_cs_id text, p_category text, p_reference_id text, p_resolution_note text DEFAULT '条件を満たしたため自動解消'::text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_alert_id UUID;
BEGIN
  UPDATE cm_alerts
  SET
    status = 'resolved',
    resolved_at = NOW(),
    resolution_note = p_resolution_note,
    updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE kaipoke_cs_id = p_kaipoke_cs_id
    AND category = p_category
    AND details->>'reference_id' = p_reference_id
    AND status != 'resolved'
  RETURNING id INTO v_alert_id;

  RETURN v_alert_id;
END;
$function$

functions.name: cm_resolve_alerts_by_termination
functions.identity_args: p_category text, p_resolution_note text
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cm_resolve_alerts_by_termination(p_category text, p_resolution_note text DEFAULT '利用者が利用終了'::text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_count INTEGER;
BEGIN
  -- 利用終了した利用者のアラートを resolved に更新
  WITH terminated_clients AS (
    SELECT kaipoke_cs_id
    FROM cm_kaipoke_info  -- ★修正: cs_ → cm_
    WHERE client_status != '利用中'  -- ★修正: status → client_status
  ),
  updated AS (
    UPDATE cm_alerts a
    SET
      status = 'resolved',
      resolved_at = NOW(),
      resolution_note = p_resolution_note,
      updated_at = NOW()
    FROM terminated_clients tc
    WHERE a.kaipoke_cs_id = tc.kaipoke_cs_id
      AND a.category = p_category
      AND a.status != 'resolved'
    RETURNING a.id
  )
  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_count FROM updated;

  RETURN v_count;
END;
$function$

functions.name: cron_sync_cs_documents
functions.result_type: TABLE(updated_infos bigint, relabeled_documents bigint, fixed_doc_names bigint, matched_kaipoke_ids bigint, filled_doc_dates bigint, unresolved bigint)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cron_sync_cs_documents()
 RETURNS TABLE(updated_infos bigint, relabeled_documents bigint, fixed_doc_names bigint, matched_kaipoke_ids bigint, filled_doc_dates bigint, unresolved bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
declare
  v_updated_infos bigint := 0;
  v_relabeled_documents bigint := 0;
  v_fixed_doc_names bigint := 0;
  v_matched_kaipoke_ids bigint := 0;
  v_filled_doc_dates bigint := 0;
  v_unresolved bigint := 0;
begin
  -- ======================================================
  -- ① cs_docs.doc_name 補正
  -- ======================================================
  with candidates as (
    select
      d.id,
      d.doc_name as old_doc_name,
      public.classify_cs_doc_label(
        coalesce(d.summary, '') || E'\n' || coalesce(d.ocr_text, ''),
        d.doc_name
      ) as new_doc_name
    from public.cs_docs d
    where coalesce(nullif(btrim(d.doc_name), ''), '分類不能') = '分類不能'
  )
  update public.cs_docs d
     set doc_name = c.new_doc_name,
         updated_at = now()
    from candidates c
   where d.id = c.id
     and coalesce(c.new_doc_name, '') <> ''
     and c.new_doc_name <> '分類不能'
     and coalesce(d.doc_name, '') is distinct from c.new_doc_name;

  get diagnostics v_fixed_doc_names = row_count;

  -- ======================================================
  -- ② kaipoke_cs_id 名寄せ
  -- ======================================================
  with src as (
    select
      d.id,
      d.kaipoke_cs_id,
      d.summary,
      d.ocr_text,
      coalesce(d.summary, '') || E'\n' || coalesce(d.ocr_text, '') as joined_text,
      public.extract_user_name_raw(coalesce(d.summary, '') || E'\n' || coalesce(d.ocr_text, '')) as extracted_name,
      public.extract_doc_date_raw(coalesce(d.summary, '') || E'\n' || coalesce(d.ocr_text, '')) as extracted_doc_date_raw
    from public.cs_docs d
    where d.kaipoke_cs_id is null
  ),
  matched as (
    select
      s.id,
      public.pick_best_kaipoke_cs_id(
        s.extracted_name,
        s.joined_text,
        s.extracted_doc_date_raw
      ) as new_kaipoke_cs_id
    from src s
  )
  update public.cs_docs d
     set kaipoke_cs_id = m.new_kaipoke_cs_id,
         updated_at = now()
    from matched m
   where d.id = m.id
     and m.new_kaipoke_cs_id is not null
     and d.kaipoke_cs_id is null;

  get diagnostics v_matched_kaipoke_ids = row_count;

  -- ======================================================
  -- ③ doc_date_raw 補完
  -- 注意: cs_docs.doc_date_raw は timestamptz
  -- extract_doc_date_raw() は text を返すので、
  -- ここでは parse 可能なものだけ timestamptz 化
  -- ======================================================
  with dates as (
    select
      d.id,
      public.extract_doc_date_raw(coalesce(d.summary, '') || E'\n' || coalesce(d.ocr_text, '')) as extracted_raw
    from public.cs_docs d
    where d.doc_date_raw is null
  ),
  parsed as (
    select
      id,
      case
        when extracted_raw ~ '^\d{4}[-/\.]\d{1,2}[-/\.]\d{1,2}$'
          then replace(replace(extracted_raw, '/', '-'), '.', '-')::date::timestamptz
        when extracted_raw ~ '^\d{4}[-/\.]\d{1,2}[-/\.]\d{1,2}日?$'
          then regexp_replace(replace(replace(extracted_raw, '/', '-'), '.', '-'), '日$', '')::date::timestamptz
        else null
      end as new_doc_date_raw
    from dates
  )
  update public.cs_docs d
     set doc_date_raw = p.new_doc_date_raw,
         updated_at = now()
    from parsed p
   where d.id = p.id
     and p.new_doc_date_raw is not null
     and d.doc_date_raw is null;

  get diagnostics v_filled_doc_dates = row_count;

  -- ======================================================
  -- ④ cs_docs -> cs_kaipoke_info.documents 同期
  -- ======================================================
  v_updated_infos := public.sync_cs_docs_to_kaipoke_documents();

  -- ======================================================
  -- ⑤ cs_kaipoke_info.documents 内 label 補正
  -- ======================================================
  with expanded as (
    select
      cki.id as cki_id,
      ordinality as ord,
      elem,
      elem->>'label' as old_label,
      public.classify_cs_doc_label(
        coalesce(elem->>'summary', '') || E'\n' || coalesce(elem->>'label', ''),
        elem->>'label'
      ) as new_label
    from public.cs_kaipoke_info cki
    cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(cki.documents::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb)) with ordinality as t(elem, ordinality)
  ),
  rebuilt as (
    select
      cki_id,
      jsonb_agg(
        case
          when coalesce(old_label, '') in ('', '分類不能', '不明', '自由登録')
            or not exists (
              select 1
              from public.user_doc_master udm
              where udm.category = 'cs_doc'
                and udm.label = old_label
            )
          then jsonb_set(elem, '{label}', to_jsonb(new_label), true)
          else elem
        end
        order by ord
      ) as new_documents,
      count(*) filter (
        where (
          coalesce(old_label, '') in ('', '分類不能', '不明', '自由登録')
          or not exists (
            select 1
            from public.user_doc_master udm
            where udm.category = 'cs_doc'
              and udm.label = old_label
          )
        )
        and coalesce(new_label, '') <> coalesce(old_label, '')
      ) as changed_count
    from expanded
    group by cki_id
  )
  update public.cs_kaipoke_info cki
     set documents = rebuilt.new_documents
    from rebuilt
   where cki.id = rebuilt.cki_id
     and rebuilt.changed_count > 0;

  select coalesce(sum(changed_count), 0)
    into v_relabeled_documents
    from (
      with expanded as (
        select
          cki.id as cki_id,
          ordinality as ord,
          elem,
          elem->>'label' as old_label,
          public.classify_cs_doc_label(
            coalesce(elem->>'summary', '') || E'\n' || coalesce(elem->>'label', ''),
            elem->>'label'
          ) as new_label
        from public.cs_kaipoke_info cki
        cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(cki.documents::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb)) with ordinality as t(elem, ordinality)
      )
      select
        cki_id,
        count(*) filter (
          where (
            coalesce(old_label, '') in ('', '分類不能', '不明', '自由登録')
            or not exists (
              select 1
              from public.user_doc_master udm
              where udm.category = 'cs_doc'
                and udm.label = old_label
            )
          )
          and coalesce(new_label, '') <> coalesce(old_label, '')
        ) as changed_count
      from expanded
      group by cki_id
    ) s;

  -- ======================================================
  -- ⑥ unresolved 件数
  -- ======================================================
  select count(*)
    into v_unresolved
    from public.cs_docs d
   where coalesce(nullif(btrim(d.doc_name), ''), '分類不能') = '分類不能'
      or d.kaipoke_cs_id is null
      or d.doc_date_raw is null;

  return query
  select
    v_updated_infos,
    v_relabeled_documents,
    v_fixed_doc_names,
    v_matched_kaipoke_ids,
    v_filled_doc_dates,
    v_unresolved;
end;
$function$

functions.name: dashboard_service_time_qualification_staff_rows
functions.result_type: TABLE(year_month text, service_date date, service_category text, total_hours numeric, staff_user_id text, qualified boolean)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dashboard_service_time_qualification_staff_rows()
 RETURNS TABLE(year_month text, service_date date, service_category text, total_hours numeric, staff_user_id text, qualified boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  with qualification_master as (
    select label
    from public.user_doc_master
    where category = 'certificate'
      and is_active = true
      and label in ('介護福祉士', '実務者研修修了')
  ),
  qualification_dates as (
    select
      fe.auth_uid,
      min(acquired.acquired_date) as qualified_from
    from public.form_entries fe
    cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(fe.attachments, '[]'::jsonb)) attachment(value)
    cross join lateral (
      select case
        when nullif(attachment.value ->> 'acquired_at', '')
             ~ '^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(0[1-9]|[12]\d|3[01])'
          then to_date(left(attachment.value ->> 'acquired_at', 10), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
      end as acquired_date
    ) acquired
    join qualification_master qm
      on qm.label = attachment.value ->> 'label'
    where fe.auth_uid is not null
      and attachment.value ->> 'type' in ('資格証明書', 'certificate', 'certification')
      and acquired.acquired_date is not null
      and to_char(acquired.acquired_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
          = left(attachment.value ->> 'acquired_at', 10)
    group by fe.auth_uid
  ),
  participating_staff as (
    select
      s.shift_start_date::date as service_date,
      s.kaipoke_cs_id,
      s.service_code,
      participant.staff_user_id,
      case
        when (coalesce(s.shift_end_date, s.shift_start_date)::date + s.shift_end_time::time)
             <= (s.shift_start_date::date + s.shift_start_time::time)
          then extract(epoch from (
            (coalesce(s.shift_end_date, s.shift_start_date)::date + s.shift_end_time::time + interval '1 day')
            - (s.shift_start_date::date + s.shift_start_time::time)
          )) / 3600
        else extract(epoch from (
          (coalesce(s.shift_end_date, s.shift_start_date)::date + s.shift_end_time::time)
          - (s.shift_start_date::date + s.shift_start_time::time)
        )) / 3600
      end::numeric as hours
    from public.shift_shift_record_view s
    cross join lateral (
      values
        (s.staff_01_user_id, true),
        (s.staff_02_user_id, not coalesce(s.staff_02_attend_flg, false)),
        (s.staff_03_user_id, not coalesce(s.staff_03_attend_flg, false))
    ) as participant(staff_user_id, is_service_staff)
    where s.shift_start_date >= date '2025-11-01'
      and coalesce(s.kaipoke_cs_id, '') not like '99999999%'
      and coalesce(s.service_code, '') not like '%キャンセル%'
      and participant.is_service_staff
      and participant.staff_user_id is not null
      and s.shift_start_time is not null
      and s.shift_end_time is not null
  ),
  resolved_service as (
    select
      ps.*,
      coalesce(
        nullif(btrim(ps.service_code), ''),
        fallback.service_code
      ) as effective_service_code
    from participating_staff ps
    left join lateral (
      select s2.service_code
      from public.shift_shift_record_view s2
      join public.shift_service_code sc2
        on sc2.service_code = s2.service_code
      where nullif(btrim(ps.service_code), '') is null
        and s2.kaipoke_cs_id = ps.kaipoke_cs_id
        and nullif(btrim(s2.service_code), '') is not null
        and s2.service_code not like '%キャンセル%'
        and (
          sc2.plan_service_category in (
            '居宅家事', '居宅身体', '通院等介助', '行動援護',
            '同行援護', '重度訪問', '移動支援'
          )
          or sc2.kaipoke_servicek in ('要介護', '要支援', '自費')
        )
      order by
        abs(s2.shift_start_date::date - ps.service_date),
        case when s2.shift_start_date::date <= ps.service_date then 0 else 1 end,
        s2.shift_start_date desc
      limit 1
    ) fallback on true
  ),
  classified_staff as (
    select
      ps.*,
      qd.qualified_from,
      case
        when sc.plan_service_category in ('居宅家事', '居宅身体', '通院等介助')
          then '障害福祉（家事・身体・通院等介助）'
        when sc.plan_service_category = '行動援護' then '行動援護'
        when sc.plan_service_category = '同行援護' then '同行援護'
        when sc.plan_service_category = '重度訪問' then '重度訪問'
        when sc.plan_service_category = '移動支援' then '移動支援'
        when sc.kaipoke_servicek = '要介護' then '訪問介護（要介護）'
        when sc.kaipoke_servicek = '要支援' then '訪問介護（要支援）'
        when sc.kaipoke_servicek = '自費' then '自費'
      end as service_category
    from resolved_service ps
    join public.user_entry_united_view_single u
      on u.user_id = ps.staff_user_id
     and u.org_unit_id is not null
    join public.shift_service_code sc
      on sc.service_code = ps.effective_service_code
    left join qualification_dates qd
      on qd.auth_uid = u.auth_uid
  )
  select
    to_char(cs.service_date, 'YYYY-MM'),
    cs.service_date,
    cs.service_category,
    cs.hours,
    cs.staff_user_id,
    coalesce(cs.qualified_from <= cs.service_date, false)
  from classified_staff cs
  where cs.service_category is not null
    and cs.hours > 0;
$function$

functions.name: get_candidate_clients_multi
functions.identity_args: p_office_ids bigint[]
functions.result_type: TABLE(kaipoke_cs_id text, client_name text, client_kana text, office_id bigint, office_name character varying)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_candidate_clients_multi(p_office_ids bigint[])
 RETURNS TABLE(kaipoke_cs_id text, client_name text, client_kana text, office_id bigint, office_name character varying)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (ci.kaipoke_cs_id, coo.id)
    ci.kaipoke_cs_id,
    ci.name AS client_name,
    ci.kana AS client_kana,
    coo.id AS office_id,
    coo.office_name
  FROM cm_kaipoke_info ci
  INNER JOIN cm_kaipoke_service_usage csu 
    ON ci.kaipoke_cs_id = csu.kaipoke_cs_id
  INNER JOIN cm_kaipoke_other_office coo 
    ON csu.office_number = coo.office_number
  WHERE coo.id = ANY(p_office_ids)
  ORDER BY ci.kaipoke_cs_id, coo.id, ci.kana;
END;
$function$

functions.name: get_foreign_keys

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_foreign_keys(target_schema text, target_table text)
 RETURNS TABLE(column_name text, foreign_schema text, foreign_table text, foreign_column text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
    select
        kcu.column_name::text,
        ccu.table_schema::text as foreign_schema,
        ccu.table_name::text as foreign_table,
        ccu.column_name::text as foreign_column
    from information_schema.table_constraints tc
    join information_schema.key_column_usage kcu
        on tc.constraint_name = kcu.constraint_name
        and tc.table_schema = kcu.table_schema
    join information_schema.constraint_column_usage ccu
        on ccu.constraint_name = tc.constraint_name
    where tc.constraint_type = 'FOREIGN KEY'
      and tc.table_schema = target_schema
      and tc.table_name = target_table;
$function$

functions.name: get_schema_tables
functions.identity_args: target_schema text
functions.result_type: TABLE(table_schema text, table_name text, object_type text, table_comment text, column_count bigint)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_schema_tables(target_schema text)
 RETURNS TABLE(table_schema text, table_name text, object_type text, table_comment text, column_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
    select
        t.table_schema::text,
        t.table_name::text,
        case t.table_type
            when 'BASE TABLE' then 'TABLE'
            when 'VIEW' then 'VIEW'
            else t.table_type
        end::text as object_type,
        coalesce(obj_description(
            (quote_ident(t.table_schema) || '.' || quote_ident(t.table_name))::regclass
        ), '')::text as table_comment,
        (select count(*)
         from information_schema.columns c
         where c.table_schema = t.table_schema
           and c.table_name = t.table_name
        ) as column_count
    from information_schema.tables t
    where t.table_schema = target_schema
      and t.table_type in ('BASE TABLE', 'VIEW')
    order by
        case t.table_type when 'BASE TABLE' then 1 else 2 end,
        t.table_name;
$function$

functions.name: get_table_columns
functions.identity_args: target_schema text, target_table text
functions.result_type: TABLE(column_name text, data_type text, udt_name text, character_maximum_length integer, numeric_precision integer, numeric_scale integer, is_nullable text, column_default text, column_comment text)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_table_columns(target_schema text, target_table text)
 RETURNS TABLE(column_name text, data_type text, udt_name text, character_maximum_length integer, numeric_precision integer, numeric_scale integer, is_nullable text, column_default text, column_comment text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
    select
        c.column_name::text,
        c.data_type::text,
        c.udt_name::text,
        c.character_maximum_length::integer,
        c.numeric_precision::integer,
        c.numeric_scale::integer,
        c.is_nullable::text,
        c.column_default::text,
        coalesce(col_description(
            (quote_ident(c.table_schema) || '.' || quote_ident(c.table_name))::regclass,
            c.ordinal_position
        ), '')::text as column_comment
    from information_schema.columns c
    where c.table_schema = target_schema
      and c.table_name = target_table
    order by c.ordinal_position;
$function$

functions.name: read_secret
functions.identity_args: secret_name text
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.read_secret(secret_name text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  secret_value TEXT;
BEGIN
  SELECT decrypted_secret INTO secret_value
  FROM vault.decrypted_secrets
  WHERE name = secret_name
  LIMIT 1;
  
  RETURN secret_value;
END;
$function$

functions.identity_args: p_from date, p_to date

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rebuild_staff_monthly_stats(p_from date DEFAULT '2025-07-01'::date, p_to date DEFAULT (date_trunc('month'::text, timezone('Asia/Tokyo'::text, now())))::date)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_month date;
  v_count integer := 0;
begin
  if p_from > p_to then
    raise exception 'p_from must be on or before p_to';
  end if;

  for v_month in
    select generate_series(date_trunc('month', p_from)::date, date_trunc('month', p_to)::date, interval '1 month')::date
  loop
    with eligible_shift_participants as (
      select s.shift_start_date::date as shift_date, participant.staff_user_id
      from shift_shift_record_view s
      cross join lateral (values
        (s.staff_01_user_id, true),
        (s.staff_02_user_id, not coalesce(s.staff_02_attend_flg, false)),
        (s.staff_03_user_id, not coalesce(s.staff_03_attend_flg, false))
      ) participant(staff_user_id, is_service_staff)
      where s.shift_start_date < (timezone('Asia/Tokyo', now())::date + 1)
        and coalesce(s.kaipoke_cs_id, '') not like '99999999%'
        and coalesce(s.service_code, '') not like '%キャンセル%'
        and participant.is_service_staff
        and nullif(btrim(participant.staff_user_id), '') is not null
        and s.shift_start_time is not null and s.shift_end_time is not null
    ), last_valid_shift as (
      select staff_user_id, max(shift_date) as last_shift_date
      from eligible_shift_participants
      group by staff_user_id
    ), staff as (
      select distinct on (u.user_id)
        u.user_id,
        coalesce(u.entry_date_latest, fe.agreed_at, fe.created_at, u.created_at)::timestamptz as hired_at,
        case when lower(btrim(coalesce(u.status, ''))) = 'removed_from_lineworks_kaipoke'
          then lvs.last_shift_date::timestamptz
        end as retired_at,
        lower(btrim(coalesce(u.system_role, u.role, ''))) as staff_role
      from users u
      join last_valid_shift lvs on lvs.staff_user_id = u.user_id
      left join form_entries fe on fe.id = u.entry_id
      where nullif(btrim(coalesce(u.user_id, '')), '') is not null
        and coalesce(u.org_unit_id, '') not in ('fb9bab81-5f4e-4725-2d34-05240f80a71a', '5b26013b-a3d4-42ab-266c-05cad5ab1c10')
      order by u.user_id, u.created_at desc nulls last
    ), counts as (
      select
        count(*) filter (where hired_at >= v_month and hired_at < v_month + interval '1 month')::integer as hired_count,
        count(*) filter (where retired_at >= v_month and retired_at < v_month + interval '1 month')::integer as retired_count,
        count(*) filter (where hired_at < v_month + interval '1 month' and (retired_at is null or retired_at >= v_month + interval '1 month'))::integer as active_count,
        count(*) filter (where hired_at < v_month + interval '1 month' and (retired_at is null or retired_at >= v_month + interval '1 month') and staff_role in ('manager', 'admin'))::integer as fulltime_count,
        count(*) filter (where hired_at < v_month + interval '1 month' and (retired_at is null or retired_at >= v_month + interval '1 month') and staff_role not in ('manager', 'admin'))::integer as other_count,
        count(*) filter (where user_id in (select staff_user_id from eligible_shift_participants where shift_date >= v_month and shift_date < (v_month + interval '1 month')::date) and hired_at < v_month + interval '1 month' and (retired_at is null or retired_at >= v_month + interval '1 month'))::integer as working_count
      from staff
    )
    insert into staff_monthly_stats (month, hired_count, retired_count, active_count, fulltime_count, other_count, working_count, calculated_at, updated_at)
    select v_month, hired_count, retired_count, active_count, fulltime_count, other_count, working_count, now(), now() from counts
    on conflict (month) do update set
      hired_count = excluded.hired_count, retired_count = excluded.retired_count,
      active_count = excluded.active_count, fulltime_count = excluded.fulltime_count,
      other_count = excluded.other_count, working_count = excluded.working_count,
      calculated_at = excluded.calculated_at, updated_at = excluded.updated_at;
    v_count := v_count + 1;
  end loop;
  return v_count;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.shift_insert_with_context(p_row jsonb, p_actor_user_id text, p_request_path text)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
declare
  v_shift_id bigint;
begin
  perform set_config('app.actor_user_id', coalesce(p_actor_user_id,''), true);
  perform set_config('app.request_path', coalesce(p_request_path,''), true);

  insert into public.shift(
    kaipoke_cs_id,
    shift_start_date,
    shift_start_time,
    shift_end_date,
    shift_end_time,
    service_code,
    staff_01_user_id,
    staff_02_user_id,
    staff_02_attend_flg,
    staff_03_user_id,
    staff_03_attend_flg,
    required_staff_count,
    two_person_work_flg,
    staff_01_role_code,
    staff_02_role_code,
    staff_03_role_code,
    judo_ido,
    tokutei_comment
  )
  values (
    p_row->>'kaipoke_cs_id',
    (p_row->>'shift_start_date')::date,
    (p_row->>'shift_start_time')::time,
    nullif(p_row->>'shift_end_date','')::date,
    nullif(p_row->>'shift_end_time','')::time,
    p_row->>'service_code',
    p_row->>'staff_01_user_id',
    p_row->>'staff_02_user_id',
    coalesce((p_row->>'staff_02_attend_flg')::boolean, false),
    p_row->>'staff_03_user_id',
    coalesce((p_row->>'staff_03_attend_flg')::boolean, false),
    coalesce((p_row->>'required_staff_count')::integer, 1),
    coalesce((p_row->>'two_person_work_flg')::boolean, false),
    p_row->>'staff_01_role_code',
    p_row->>'staff_02_role_code',
    p_row->>'staff_03_role_code',
    p_row->>'judo_ido',
    p_row->>'tokutei_comment'
  )
  returning shift_id into v_shift_id;

  return v_shift_id;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.shift_update_with_context(p_shift_id bigint, p_patch jsonb, p_actor_user_id text, p_request_path text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
begin
  perform set_config('app.actor_user_id', coalesce(p_actor_user_id,''), true);
  perform set_config('app.request_path', coalesce(p_request_path,''), true);

  update public.shift s
  set
    shift_start_date =
      case when p_patch ? 'shift_start_date' then (p_patch->>'shift_start_date')::date else s.shift_start_date end,
    shift_end_date   =
      case when p_patch ? 'shift_end_date' then (p_patch->>'shift_end_date')::date else s.shift_end_date end,
    shift_start_time =
      case when p_patch ? 'shift_start_time' then (p_patch->>'shift_start_time')::time else s.shift_start_time end,
    shift_end_time   =
      case when p_patch ? 'shift_end_time' then (p_patch->>'shift_end_time')::time else s.shift_end_time end,

    service_code =
      case when p_patch ? 'service_code' then (p_patch->>'service_code') else s.service_code end,

    staff_01_user_id =
      case when p_patch ? 'staff_01_user_id' then (p_patch->>'staff_01_user_id') else s.staff_01_user_id end,
    staff_02_user_id =
      case when p_patch ? 'staff_02_user_id' then (p_patch->>'staff_02_user_id') else s.staff_02_user_id end,
    staff_03_user_id =
      case when p_patch ? 'staff_03_user_id' then (p_patch->>'staff_03_user_id') else s.staff_03_user_id end,

    staff_01_role_code =
      case when p_patch ? 'staff_01_role_code' then (p_patch->>'staff_01_role_code') else s.staff_01_role_code end,
    staff_02_role_code =
      case when p_patch ? 'staff_02_role_code' then (p_patch->>'staff_02_role_code') else s.staff_02_role_code end,
    staff_03_role_code =
      case when p_patch ? 'staff_03_role_code' then (p_patch->>'staff_03_role_code') else s.staff_03_role_code end,

    judo_ido =
      case when p_patch ? 'judo_ido' then (p_patch->>'judo_ido') else s.judo_ido end,

    tokutei_comment =
      case when p_patch ? 'tokutei_comment' then (p_patch->>'tokutei_comment') else s.tokutei_comment end,

    staff_02_attend_flg =
      case when p_patch ? 'staff_02_attend_flg' then (p_patch->>'staff_02_attend_flg')::boolean else s.staff_02_attend_flg end,
    staff_03_attend_flg =
      case when p_patch ? 'staff_03_attend_flg' then (p_patch->>'staff_03_attend_flg')::boolean else s.staff_03_attend_flg end,

    required_staff_count =
      case when p_patch ? 'required_staff_count' then (p_patch->>'required_staff_count')::integer else s.required_staff_count end,
    two_person_work_flg =
      case when p_patch ? 'two_person_work_flg' then (p_patch->>'two_person_work_flg')::boolean else s.two_person_work_flg end

  where s.shift_id = p_shift_id;
end;
$function$

functions.name: snapshot_biz_stats_shift_sum
functions.identity_args: p_year_month text
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.snapshot_biz_stats_shift_sum(p_year_month text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
declare
  v_month_start date;
  v_from_month date;
  v_to_month_excl date;
  v_affected integer;
begin
  if position('-' in p_year_month) > 0 then
    v_month_start := to_date(p_year_month || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD');
  else
    v_month_start := to_date(p_year_month || '01', 'YYYYMMDD');
  end if;

  v_from_month := (v_month_start - interval '2 month')::date;
  v_to_month_excl := (v_month_start + interval '1 month')::date;

  -- ✅ 当月は作り直し
  delete from public.biz_stats_shift_sum
  where metric = 'team_service_hours'
    and snapshot_month = v_month_start;

  with
  target_months as (
    select generate_series(v_from_month, v_month_start, interval '1 month')::date as month_start
  ),
  base_shifts as (
    select
      s.*,
      date_trunc('month', s.shift_start_date::timestamptz)::date as month_start,
      to_char(date_trunc('month', s.shift_start_date::timestamptz), 'YYYYMM') as year_month,
      extract(epoch from upper(s.shift_timerange) - lower(s.shift_timerange)) / 3600.0 as shift_hours
    from shift s
    where
      s.shift_start_date is not null
      and s.shift_start_time is not null
      and s.shift_end_time is not null
      and s.shift_start_date >= v_from_month
      and s.shift_start_date <  v_to_month_excl
      and s.kaipoke_cs_id !~~ '99999999%'
      and (s.service_code is null or s.service_code !~~* '%キャンセル%')
  ),

  participants as (
    -- staff_01
    select
      b.month_start,
      b.year_month,
      b.shift_hours,
      coalesce(u.org_unit_id, 'UNASSIGNED') as orgunitid
    from base_shifts b
    left join user_entry_united_view_single u
      on u.user_id = b.staff_01_user_id
    where nullif(b.staff_01_user_id, '') is not null

    union all

    -- staff_02（attend_flg=true は除外）
    select
      b.month_start,
      b.year_month,
      b.shift_hours,
      coalesce(u.org_unit_id, 'UNASSIGNED') as orgunitid
    from base_shifts b
    left join user_entry_united_view_single u
      on u.user_id = b.staff_02_user_id
    where
      nullif(b.staff_02_user_id, '') is not null
      and coalesce(b.staff_02_attend_flg, false) = false

    union all

    -- staff_03（attend_flg=true は除外）
    select
      b.month_start,
      b.year_month,
      b.shift_hours,
      coalesce(u.org_unit_id, 'UNASSIGNED') as orgunitid
    from base_shifts b
    left join user_entry_united_view_single u
      on u.user_id = b.staff_03_user_id
    where
      nullif(b.staff_03_user_id, '') is not null
      and coalesce(b.staff_03_attend_flg, false) = false
  ),

  -- ===== Lv3集計（従来） =====
  monthly_lv3 as (
    select
      tm.month_start,
      to_char(tm.month_start, 'YYYYMM') as year_month,
      p.orgunitid,
      round(coalesce(sum(p.shift_hours), 0)::numeric, 2) as total_hours
    from target_months tm
    left join participants p
      on p.month_start = tm.month_start
    group by tm.month_start, p.orgunitid
  ),

  monthly_lv3_named as (
    select
      m.month_start,
      m.year_month,
      m.orgunitid,
      coalesce(o.orgunitname, case when m.orgunitid='UNASSIGNED' then '未割当' else m.orgunitid end) as orgunitname,
      m.total_hours
    from monthly_lv3 m
    left join orgs o on o.orgunitid = m.orgunitid
  ),

  -- ===== Lv2集計（NEW） =====
  monthly_lv2 as (
    select
      m.month_start,
      m.year_month,
      os.lv2_id as orgunitid,
      max(os.lv2_name) as orgunitname,
      round(sum(m.total_hours)::numeric, 2) as total_hours
    from monthly_lv3_named m
    join orgs_sort os
      on os.orgunitid = m.orgunitid
    where
      os.lv2_id is not null
      and m.orgunitid <> 'UNASSIGNED'
      and os.orgunitid <> os.lv2_id          -- Lv2自身の行を二重にしない（保険）
    group by m.month_start, m.year_month, os.lv2_id
  ),

  monthly_total as (
    select
      month_start,
      year_month,
      'TOTAL' as orgunitid,
      'total' as orgunitname,
      round(sum(total_hours)::numeric, 2) as total_hours
    from monthly_lv3_named
    group by month_start, year_month
  ),

  unioned as (
    -- ✅ Lv2 → Lv3 → TOTAL（表示側で並べ替えるので順序自体はどっちでもOK）
    select * from monthly_lv2
    union all
    select * from monthly_lv3_named
    union all
    select * from monthly_total
  ),

  with_avg as (
    select
      u.*,
      round(
        avg(u.total_hours) over (
          partition by u.orgunitid
          order by u.month_start
          rows between 2 preceding and current row
        )::numeric,
        2
      ) as avg_3m_hours
    from unioned u
  )

  insert into public.biz_stats_shift_sum (
    metric, snapshot_month, year_month, orgunitid, orgunitname, value, avg_3m, snapshot_at, meta
  )
  select
    'team_service_hours' as metric,
    v_month_start as snapshot_month,
    w.year_month,
    w.orgunitid,
    w.orgunitname,
    w.total_hours as value,
    w.avg_3m_hours as avg_3m,
    now() as snapshot_at,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'source', 'shift staff team (lv3 + lv2 aggregated)',
      'range_from', to_char(v_from_month, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
      'range_to', to_char(v_month_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    ) as meta
  from with_avg w
  where w.month_start = v_month_start;

  get diagnostics v_affected = row_count;
  return v_affected;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.staff_retirement_review_rows()
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id text, staff_name text, status text, lw_userid text, last_shift_date date, next_shift_date date, hired_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  with shifts as (
    select s.shift_start_date::date shift_date, p.staff_user_id from shift_shift_record_view s
    cross join lateral (values (s.staff_01_user_id,true),(s.staff_02_user_id,not coalesce(s.staff_02_attend_flg,false)),(s.staff_03_user_id,not coalesce(s.staff_03_attend_flg,false))) p(staff_user_id,ok)
    where coalesce(s.kaipoke_cs_id,'') not like '99999999%' and coalesce(s.service_code,'') not like '%キャンセル%' and p.ok and p.staff_user_id is not null and s.shift_start_time is not null and s.shift_end_time is not null
  ), activity as (
    select staff_user_id, max(shift_date) filter (where shift_date < current_date) last_shift_date, min(shift_date) filter (where shift_date >= current_date) next_shift_date from shifts group by staff_user_id
  )
  select u.user_id,concat_ws(' ',fe.last_name_kanji,fe.first_name_kanji),u.status,u.lw_userid,a.last_shift_date,a.next_shift_date,coalesce(u.entry_date_latest,fe.agreed_at,fe.created_at,u.created_at)::timestamptz
  from users u left join activity a on a.staff_user_id=u.user_id left join form_entries fe on fe.id=u.entry_id
  where coalesce(u.org_unit_id,'') not in ('fb9bab81-5f4e-4725-2d34-05240f80a71a','5b26013b-a3d4-42ab-266c-05cad5ab1c10','6ca601b9-2699-475d-2ba2-0564acb86091','7a159f5c-50ec-4281-282d-05bbebfd46f0');
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_cs_docs_to_kaipoke_documents()
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
declare
  v_updated_count bigint := 0;
begin
  with doc_rows as (
    select
      d.kaipoke_cs_id,
      d.id,
      d.created_at,
      d.updated_at,
      public.build_cs_document_json_from_cs_docs(
        d.id,
        d.url,
        coalesce(nullif(btrim(d.doc_name), ''), '分類不能'),
        d.doc_date_raw,
        d.source,
        d.summary,
        d.doc_type_id,
        d.classification_confidence,
        d.created_at,
        d.updated_at,
        d.meta
      ) as doc_json
    from public.cs_docs d
    where d.kaipoke_cs_id is not null
  ),
  grouped as (
    select
      cki.id as cki_id,
      jsonb_agg(
        dr.doc_json
        order by
          (dr.doc_json->>'doc_date_raw') desc nulls last,
          dr.updated_at desc,
          dr.created_at desc,
          dr.id desc
      ) as new_documents
    from public.cs_kaipoke_info cki
    join doc_rows dr
      on dr.kaipoke_cs_id = cki.kaipoke_cs_id
    group by cki.id
  )
  update public.cs_kaipoke_info cki
     set documents = grouped.new_documents
    from grouped
   where cki.id = grouped.cki_id
     and coalesce(cki.documents::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb)
         is distinct from
         coalesce(grouped.new_documents, '[]'::jsonb);

  get diagnostics v_updated_count = row_count;
  return v_updated_count;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.wf_my_user_id()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
  select u.user_id
  from public.users u
  where u.auth_user_id = auth.uid()
  limit 1
$function$
